title: Model texture generation
author: Schaf-Unschaf
selftext:
Heya.

I was never good in doing any kind of texturing or drawing besides smaller, simple HUD elements. But I'm getting better at blender creating my own models (mid-poly spaceships).

But since they will need some textures, too, I'm looking for a good tool creating those. Do you guys have any recommendations for me? I was using ChatGPT right now for creating tillable textures and decals for the ships but it's hard getting good results (yes, I'm feeding it pictures of the ships and their UV mappings and explaining what I have in mind).

comments.author: RUSuper
comments.body: Maybe allow chatGPT or Claude (Claude will need access to your OpenAI API so it can create images). They can via MCP do it in blender directly and apply them for you to see. Or you can try a service like TripoAI and if it actually works for you also (though I'm not sure if it is possible to generate textures only without previously generating 3D model there).
